title: Average debit transaction amount by account type, 2025
prompt: What's the average debit transaction amount in 2025, broken down by account type?
population: Debit transactions in 2025, joined to accounts for account_type.
metricDefinition: average(amount) for debit transactions in 2025, grouped by account_type.
transformationPlan: filter transactions to type = debit and 2025
referenceSql: SELECT a.account_type, avg(t.amount) AS avg_debit_amount FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE t.type = 'debit' AND t.occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND t.occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY a.account_type
